## Loose ends, none blocking

- **Nothing is unpushed.** `dashboards-push` ran at 20:35Z on the 6th and
  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.

  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.

  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.

  origin carries `5e89a13`; the timer still fires nightly at 23:33.
- **74 series are dead at source** — 45 Productivity, 23 PPI, 4 CPI, 2 ECI —
  confirmed against the BLS API, not just against FRED. Nothing to recover, and
  none of them is drawn.
- **The flatness check is calibrated and quiet.** Three panels carry
  `data-span="intended: <why>"` — JOLTS `cSep`, payroll `cUnSex`, CPI `cVehM`.
  Add the same attribute when a new one turns out to be deliberate.
- **`frb.wage_tracker` has no calendar rows, and that is correct** — FRED
  release 637 publishes zero forward dates. Not a gap.
- **An MCP over the database is wanted but deliberately deferred** until more
  countries are ingested. The shape settled on: a read-only role, and
  intention-shaped tools over the existing `macro/` python — `series`,
  `as_first_reported`, `revisions`, `search_series` — never a `run_sql`
  gateway, because the rules that make this database correct are not in its
  schema. Only a shell-bearing client can reach the data today; nothing on
  claude.ai can.
- **`~/bigricebowl` still has an unpushed commit** (`5995cf5`, the EverOS pin)
  plus older uncommitted deletions that are not mine.
- **The one-off scripts are in `~/ingest_run/`** with their logs.
